parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.
> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

parameters.name: IncludeKnowledgeBaseResults
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the recall results. Default value: false.

parameters.name: KnowledgeParams
parameters.description: The knowledge retrieval parameter object. If not specified, only chat is performed.

parameters.name: ModelParams
parameters.description: The large language model (LLM) invocation parameter object.

parameters.name: PromptParams
parameters.description: The system prompt template, which must include {{ text_chunks }}, {{ user_system_prompt }}, {{ graph_entities }}, and {{ graph_relations }}. If not specified, this part does not take effect.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.
